title: Use this workflow: start with an Image Reference, add Custom Instructions…
content: Use this workflow: start with an Image Reference, add Custom Instructions, generate a storyboard with GPT Image 2.0, then convert the storyboard into a Seedance 2.0 prompt.
tips: Use this workflow: start with an Image Reference, add Custom Instructions, generate a storyboard with GPT Image 2.0, then convert the storyboard into a Seedance 2.0 prompt.

es.content: Utiliza este flujo de trabajo: comienza con una Referencia de Imagen, añade Instrucciones Personalizadas, genera un storyboard con GPT Image 2.0, luego convierte el storyboard en un prompt de Seedance 2.0.

fr.content: Utilisez ce flux de travail : commencez par une Référence d'Image, ajoutez des Instructions Personnalisées, générez un storyboard avec GPT Image 2.0, puis convertissez le storyboard en un prompt Seedance 2.0.

ja.content: このワークフローを使用します：Image Referenceから始め、Custom Instructionsを追加し、GPT Image 2.0でストーリーボードを生成し、そのストーリーボードをSeedance 2.0 promptに変換します。

ko.content: 이 워크플로우를 사용하세요: 이미지 참조로 시작하고, 사용자 정의 지침을 추가한 후, GPT Image 2.0으로 스토리보드를 생성하고, 그 스토리보드를 Seedance 2.0 prompt로 변환합니다.

pt.content: Use este fluxo de trabalho: comece com uma Referência de Imagem, adicione Instruções Personalizadas, gere um storyboard com GPT Image 2.0, depois converta o storyboard em um prompt Seedance 2.0.
